---
title: "Projects"

params:
  image_dir: "docs/images"
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo=FALSE, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE)
# Source assets live in docs/images; rendered HTML also lives in docs/.
# Centralize the source directory here, while generating browser-relative URLs.
site_image <- function(filename) {
  source_file <- file.path(params$image_dir, filename)
  if (!file.exists(source_file)) stop("Missing image: ", source_file)
  file.path("images", filename)
}
```

## Workforce Development

Our training programs offer undergraduate students, graduate students, and early-career scientists opportunities to engage in research experiences both domestically and internationally while advancing their professional development.


**Research Experience for Undergraduates**

![](`r site_image("ecoreu.png")`){width=85%}


[NSF-REU (2024-2027)](https://www.nsf.gov/awardsearch/show-award/?AWD_ID=2349682&HistoricalAwards=false): REU SITE: Assessment and sustainable management of ecosystem at the nexus of food, energy, and water systems.

[NSF-REU (2021-2024)](https://www.nsf.gov/awardsearch/show-award/?AWD_ID=2051120&HistoricalAwards=false): REU SITE: Assessment and sustainable management of ecosystem at the nexus of food, energy, and water systems.
